subject: How to get more details regarding compile warning (not from compiler)?

messages.author: 4a248770402c04bc
messages.subject: How to get more details regarding compile warning (not from compiler)?
parts:
After compiling my model, the R console prints "Warning: R object of different size than NimArrDouble. R obj has size 1 but NimArrDbl has size 3291." Is there a way to find out the names of the R object and NimArrDouble? 

Cheers,
Gregory
